kpis.definition: Non-demo merchant with active/live/monetizing Recover lifecycle or a connected production integration.
Deduplicated lead that passes current evidence, fit, regulatory and contactability policy.
P5 evidence-backed merchant opportunity; not theoretical market size.
Completed governed Recover acceptance with canonical mandate evidence.
Realized savings from fully verified reports only.
Merchant collected cash plus separately evidenced provider paid revenue; never pipeline.
Known expected values multiplied by explicit probabilities; unknown values excluded and counted.
All attributable paid media, tools, enrichment, email, AI, people and agency costs divided by attributed new customers; missing cost categories make CAC unknown.
CAC divided by evidenced contribution margin per period; unknown if either input is missing.
Unique entities reaching a later canonical funnel stage divided by unique entities in the selected earlier stage.
